label: In-trip AI use for translation
question: What do travellers use AI for during a trip?
answer: Translation leads in-trip use at 45%, followed by activity suggestions at 44% and navigation at 40%.
sample: In-trip use among AI users, 33 markets
methodology: Booking.com Global AI Sentiment Report, April–May 2025, among AI users in travel. 96% of AI users reported using it while travelling.
